label: rem:mass-energy-pair-creation
title: Pair-creation threshold in terms of energy
html:
The energy \mathfrak{E} = \mathfrak{m} \cdot c_q^2 (energy) restates the pair-production threshold.

Pair creation reinterpreted. The pair production threshold (pair creation energy) becomes:

  \mathfrak{E}_{\gamma}  \geq 
  (\mathfrak{m}_{e^-} + \mathfrak{m}_{e^+}) \cdot c_q^2
  =  \frac{\mathfrak{m}_{e^-} + \mathfrak{m}_{e^+}}{(q-1)^2}.

The crossing energies are a separate quantity (energy is not crossing energy). The net crossing energy of the pair is \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{cross}}(e^-) + \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{cross}}(e^+) = 3(q - q^{-1}) \approx 0.630, and the absolute crossing energies sum to 3(q + q^{-1}) = 6\cosh(\ln q) \approx 6.033 Skein units.
